## Is this a template bug or a content bug?

- [ ] **Template bug** — affects all forking users (e.g., build script throws, adapter emits wrong frontmatter, series indexer skips a part). File here.
- [ ] **Content bug** — only affects my fork (e.g., my custom adapter has issues). Don't file here; that's your fork's issue.
